decisions.statement: Every query is resolved to a track before anything is played.
The first track begins playing the way `akasha music play` begins a track.
A track after the first is queued rather than played.
The tracks are queued in the order the queries were written.
An artist named has every query rather than the first alone.
A call naming no query is refused.
Each track is named as soon as that track reaches Spotify.
A call that threw part way names those tracks in its refusal.
The playing and the queueing are handed in.

definition: the command playing the first of a set of tracks and queueing the rest behind it
